question: By what percentage was the cost per kg of gain in T1 lower than in the control group?
rendered:
To find the percentage by which the cost per kg of gain in T1 was lower than in the control group, we need to calculate the difference in cost per kg of gain and divide it by the cost per kg of gain of the control group.

Cost per kg of gain in T1 = 169.94
Cost per kg of gain in the control group = 210

Difference in cost per kg of gain = 210 - 169.94 = 40.06

Percentage by which the cost per kg of gain in T1 was lower than in the control group = (40.06 / 210) * 100 = 19.05%
